python - <<'EOF'
import io, os
from unittest.mock import patch
from dotenv.main import DotEnv, load_dotenv, dotenv_values

for ov in (True, False):
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {"K": "old"}, clear=True):
        DotEnv(None, stream=io.StringIO("K=new"), override=ov).set_as_environment_variables()
        print("override=%s -> %s" % (ov, os.environ["K"]))

with patch.dict(os.environ, {"K": "old"}, clear=True):
    load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("K=new"))
    print("load_dotenv default ->", os.environ["K"])
with patch.dict(os.environ, {"K": "old"}, clear=True):
    load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("K=new"), override=True)
    print("load_dotenv override=True ->", os.environ["K"])
EOF
